steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Rat King.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What of them?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I said as much, this city has no need of further bloodshed. If they can escape, let them escape.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: To miss your old master is noble. And you spent your loyalty to buy the rights of your fellows to live on. That was a charitable act. But you must not get greedy in your requests.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...Y- yeah. But after that, that was way out of step with Lungmen's rules...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You learn quick.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have heard that long before Siracusa became what it is today, there was a time when the mafia there had some unwritten rules kept for survival's sake.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The people obeyed them, the people accepted them, and in turbulent times, the mafia came to be the most trusted group in society.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Then, they sold out, they traded in violence, and we came to where we are today.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Lungmen has its laws, and I have my own code.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Even Penguin Logistics has a set of rules for how they do whatever they want at all times, although they're all wildly different.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Rat King, if the boss back then... if Mr. Gambino didn't pull his sword on you the first time you met, would things still have turned out like this?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I gave him a chance. Both before and after that moment. It was far more than just that.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But from time to time, and especially in business, first impressions are very important. You understand?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...*Pant pant*.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: There is... the exit! It's close!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...Who's there?! Come out!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So you ain't dead. That's a surprise. Turns out the Rat King ain't so thorough.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...The wound you gave me still aches, Capone. I'm real glad you came to face me yourself.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So I can kill you with my own hands.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: All of Lungmen's after us. I really don't wanna waste time on you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So let's get this over with.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're gonna pay for betraying the Family...
Haha. Family. Family, huh.
That word sure brings me back. Hey, have either of you seen Texas?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Th- that smell...!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...a Lone Wolf. What are you doing in Lungmen?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, Texas is here. Need I say more?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: By the way, can you really call yourselves a 'Family' after you bolted from Siracusa to get away from all the responsibilities of being a Family? Can you still call yourselves 'Sicilian?'

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Would the one who plundered your proud and glorious history... Miss Sicilia herself, would she agree?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Shut up! Don't ever speak of her in front of me!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're nothin' but a traitor! Who are you to call us...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's enough, ass.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh, you're wounded? I smell blood. Wolf's blood. Mmm, is that what they call the smell of home?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Texas is different now, huh?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Really really different. A couple old friends from Siracusa come knocking on her door and she lets them leave Lungmen alive?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's so inhospitable. Downright shameful. But it's okay, I'll finish the job for her.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Maybe if I bring her the corpses of a couple paisans from Siracusa that'll get her nice and worked up. Ooh, yeah, that's a great idea...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You think she can escape? From the shadow of her Family, I mean? From her past?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...Capone, stand firm.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hah. Now we're gonna fight side by side? What happened to your honor and Family?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Call it self-preservation.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hmph. You scared?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Let's just say I don't want her to be the one who kills me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...Good point. If I'm gonna die, I'd rather make it to an open casket.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hahahaha! Are you trembling?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're going to fight me when you can barely stand up straight?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All right, sure. Watching the life leave your eyes as you struggle to live sounds like a good time.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm going to count to ten.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Run.
